findings.title: Full any/any/any permit
findings.where: security policies from-zone untrust to-zone trust policy any-any
findings.recommendation: Restrict source, destination and application to the strict minimum (least privilege). A permit any/any/any defeats the point of filtering.
fix: # delete security policies from-zone untrust to-zone trust policy any-any
# set security policies from-zone untrust to-zone trust policy any-any match source-address <SRC_OBJECT>
# set security policies from-zone untrust to-zone trust policy any-any match destination-address <DST_OBJECT>
# set security policies from-zone untrust to-zone trust policy any-any match application <APP>

findings.title: Inbound traffic from an external zone to destination any
findings.where: security policies from-zone untrust to-zone trust policy any-any
findings.recommendation: Traffic initiated from the Internet must never target 'any' as destination: target the published host and go through a reverse proxy/WAF where applicable.

findings.title: External zone with no screen (ids-option)
findings.recommendation: Attach a screen to this zone: SYN-flood, ip-spoofing, scan, land, teardrop protection… Recommended baseline.
fix: set security screen ids-option untrust-screen icmp flood threshold 1000
set security screen ids-option untrust-screen ip spoofing
set security screen ids-option untrust-screen tcp syn-flood alarm-threshold 1024
set security screen ids-option untrust-screen tcp syn-flood attack-threshold 2000
set security screen ids-option untrust-screen tcp land
set security zones security-zone untrust screen untrust-screen

findings.title: Permit with no logging
findings.where: security policies from-zone untrust to-zone trust policy any-any
fix: set security policies from-zone untrust to-zone trust policy any-any then log session-close

findings.title: No remote logging (syslog host)
findings.recommendation: Send logs to an external collector/SIEM (traceability, retention, correlation).
fix: # set system syslog host <SIEM_IP> any info

findings.title: No login banner
findings.recommendation: Display a legal warning at login.
fix: # set system login message "Access restricted - authorized use only"

findings.title: NTP not configured
findings.recommendation: Synchronize the clock (essential for log timestamping).

findings.title: Internal zone with no screen
findings.recommendation: Even a minimal screen (ip-spoofing) on internal zones is a useful defense in depth.
